name: 44115 · Cleveland, OH
findings: ZIP 44115 (Cleveland) has 261 nonprofit organizations. 140 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 123 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44115 (Cleveland) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
